method.unknown_slots: Skip every anchor containing a source mask; masks are not wildcards.
method.same_page_policy: Retain separately; do not discard possible same-page companions.
method.ordering: Descending minimum of the two coverage fractions, then matched-position total, then IDs.
method.limit: Anchor coverage is retrieval evidence only; it does not establish a repeated message, a key, source grouping or historical plaintext.

composition_control.method: Independently shuffle each target with one deterministic Python Random stream, preserving its length, coordinate counts and unknown count. This is a sensitivity diagnostic, not a p-value.

known_cross_page_checks.relationship: Known truncated cross-copy; source-date conflict retained
